name: Salesforce Transit Center
note: Pelli Clarke Pelli 2018, with PWP's Salesforce Park on the roof, the Mission Street gondola and the bridge from Salesforce Tower. Placed at a point with a size, not on its OSM footprint: way/542375290 carries layer=-1 and relation/8524888 level=3, and the bake drops both. Size and centre measured off way/542375290 (438 x 56 m, long axis at 45.1 deg, centre 37.789107 -122.396877). rotateDeg 135 (= front 315): the model's front (+z) faces bearing 315, the Mission/Minna side, where the gondola and the bridge are; its long axis runs along 45/225. Written as rotateDeg, not front, because the bake's deck placement (src/city/bridge-decks.ts `placement`) reads only rotateDeg — the park is a deck its OSM paths are pinned to (src/city/sf/bridges.ts SALESFORCE_PARK_DECKS). It was front 45 until 2026-10-02, written when `front` meant the model's back: the whole complex stood at right angles across Mission Street. baseY -81.5: the lowest ground under the outline (-81.0) less half a metre, as the game drapes it — given so the bake and the game agree where the deck is. coversRaised: the park's OSM paths, now on the deck, are drawn by the model, not as generic bridge decks (docs/SALESFORCE-PARK.md).

name: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts Gallery
note: Modelled from the OWNER'S OWN STRUCTURAL DESCRIPTION (2026-09-23) plus the front elevation he supplied, after two bails: the Metreon is across the street and in every photograph, every Mapillary frame shows the rear (BUGS.md #128), and this way is ONE polygon with no building:parts. An L-shaped, one-tall-level, windowless box of corrugated pale metal on a dark stone base, three glazed barrel vaults breaking the roofline at one end of the Mission Street front, the entrance at the far end, and a patio cut out of the far corner with the 'boat pitched down' glass structure and the rectangular fountain. Everything is derived from the ring: the L and the patio are the two biggest empty bounding-box corners, the front is the longer of the two arms flanking the re-entrant quadrant, and the three tangent vaults have radius = a sixth of the bay's front. No `front` bearing on purpose (BUGS.md #117): the builder uses no axis names. See src/render/landmarks/sf/ybca.ts; references in docs/shots/refs/sf-commons/24563073/. HEIGHT: OSM says 28 m; the owner's own description is ONE TALL LEVEL and the entrance photograph's canopy and doors scale a box of about sixteen metres, so 16 is used here, the same call as Rincon Annex above (BUGS.md #126, believed the photograph). At 28 the vault crowns cannot clear the parapet and the blank box reads as a warehouse. GROUND FLOOR IS LEVEL 2, the garden level (docs/YERBA-BUENA.md, the authoritative level model): the cladding, glazing and entrance start at the gardens builder's exported DECK_H and everything below it is the retaining face the entrance steps climb.

Placed at a point with a size, not on its OSM footprint: way/542375290 carries layer=-1 and relation/8524888 level=3, and the bake drops both. Size and centre measured off way/542375290 (438 x 56 m, long axis at 45.1 deg, centre 37.789107 -122.396877). rotateDeg 135 (= front 315): the model's front (+z) faces bearing 315, the Mission/Minna side, where the gondola and the bridge are; its long axis runs along 45/225. Written as rotateDeg, not front, because the bake's deck placement (src/city/bridge-decks.ts `placement`) reads only rotateDeg — the park is a deck its OSM paths are pinned to (src/city/sf/bridges.ts SALESFORCE_PARK_DECKS). It was front 45 until 2026-10-02, written when `front` meant the model's back: the whole complex stood at right angles across Mission Street. baseY -81.5: the lowest ground under the outline (-81.0) less half a metre, as the game drapes it — given so the bake and the game agree where the deck is. coversRaised: the park's OSM paths, now on the deck, are drawn by the model, not as generic bridge decks (docs/SALESFORCE-PARK.md).

note: sf/scratch-1.ts, hand primitives via new ./pagoda-kit.ts (pagodaTier/pagodaFinial): building=pagoda, a freestanding five-tier tapering spire on a 49-vertex near-circular plan, height tag a nonsense 0.01 so no baked ring exists at all (confirmed absent from every tiles/*.json) -- built round from a fixed radius/height instead of a measured ring. No photograph; restrained to the plain tier taper and eave overhang, height set from the real building's known ~30m. Escalated on FORM: the roof form IS the building, a known kit gap (tiered round taper) recorded in pagoda-kit.ts for reuse by the Japanese Tea Garden's pagoda later.

name: San Francisco Armory
note: sf/scratch-1.ts, hand primitives (faceBand over the real baked ring + hand-built castellated corner towers): Moorish Revival brick fortress, 19m tag, no photograph. Escalated on measured plan evidence -- the baked 17-vertex ring already carries two 2-3m bump-outs flanked by chamfered corners on the long north wall -- so the main mass is faceBand run straight over fit.ring (every bump/chamfer comes through as baked), with a castellated brick tower rising above the roofline at each end of the ring's own longest wall and a crenellated parapet between them.

name: Woolf House
note: sf/scratch-1.ts, hand primitives (faceBand over the real 132-point ring + an explicit per-edge loop): owner note 'simple repeating but interesting'. The repeat (a diagonal sawtooth of short alternating chords, measured against the baked ring in tiles/4_-6.json, in metres, never raw lat/lon) is already the ring itself, so faceBand over the real fit.ring reproduces the massing exactly; a second loop over every ring edge finds each short 'return' chord of the sawtooth and drops a thin balcony rail across it so the repeating unit reads at a glance. Ring is CONCAVE -- offsetRing used for the cornice inset, never insetRing.

name: Round House Café
note: sf/scratch-1.ts, hand primitives (prism cylinders, no faceted ring): a literally circular plan, 34-vertex ring, continuous 360deg heading sweep, 1.4-1.9m chords. Built round -- only the ring's centroid and mean radius are taken from fit.ring, then drawn as true 32-sided prism cylinders, never the baked 34-gon's own facets. 16m height tag corrected down to a plain one-storey drum (a single-room diner, not a multi-storey building); no photograph.

name: Chase Center
note: The Warriors' arena (Manica, 2019). Tagged building=yes, but it falls outside the bake's DETAIL box, so it is in pkg.fringe as coarse massing and the loader can find no ring for it — hence a lat/lon/size entry; the OSM way is named only so the fringe lump is removed. front=180 puts the model's +x east, so the two office blocks and the garage stand on the Third Street (west) side and the entrance canopy faces north to Warriors Way.

name: Aquarium of the Bay
note: sf/waterfront-2.ts, tower() kit: no reference in docs/shots/refs (its one Mapillary frame is marked junk); built from Wikimedia Commons 'Aquarium of the Bay 2025a.jpg' (Commons category 'Aquarium of the Bay - Building'), a clear plaza-side daylight exterior. Two-tier massing following the curved pier-head footprint: navy-blue lower wall with painted mural panels, cream upper band behind a perimeter railing, a small square lantern near the ridge, a run of flagpoles. 'AQUARIUM OF THE BAY' is a real sign() on the plaza-facing wall, not a hand-blocked font. OSM's 15 m tag matches the photo's two-storey-plus-deck scale and is used unmodified.

name: Moscone Center North

name: Moscone Center South
note: CORRECTION 2026-09-23: the `mosconeHall` preset that stood here (a 20 m glass box from ring-tower.ts, lowered to 8 earlier the same day) is REMOVED, not lowered again — at any height it stood where `mosconeSouthDeck`'s own surface and parapet already are (sf/yerba-buena.ts, a separate lat/lon landmark that already caps this way properly) and blocked the open Howard skybridge's landing (docs/MOSCONE-SOUTH.md). This entry now names no `procedural`/`file` at all — a PLACEHOLDER (render/landmarks.ts's own third kind): the raw OSM box is still taken out of the bake (`replacedIds` counts placeholders, not only replacements), but nothing new is built in its place, since `mosconeSouthDeck` is what actually stands here. The real hall this way represents is level 1, mostly below the deck and visible only from Howard Street; the above-ground Howard-facing mass belongs to a different way (way/426708093, queued manual, not this entry's).
